description: Cross-references for Gov. Code § 13950 CalVCB purpose and framework

cross_references.title: California Constitution, Article I, § 28 — Marsy's Law
cross_references.relationship: Constitutional mandate: Marsy's Law § 28(b)(13) provides the constitutional right to seek compensation that § 13950 et seq. implements. The CalVCB program is the Legislature's vehicle for fulfilling the constitutional guarantee.

cross_references.title: Gov. Code § 13955 — Eligibility for Compensation
cross_references.relationship: § 13950 states the purpose; § 13955 defines who qualifies. The liberal-construction mandate of § 13950 governs how § 13955 eligibility standards should be applied.

cross_references.title: Gov. Code § 13956 — Denial Grounds
cross_references.relationship: § 13956 denial grounds must be applied consistent with the § 13950 compensatory purpose. Mechanical denial without case-specific inquiry is inconsistent with the statutory mandate.

cross_references.title: Gov. Code § 13957 — Scope of Compensable Losses
cross_references.relationship: The types of loss compensable under § 13957 should be interpreted broadly consistent with § 13950's purpose of compensating crime victims for direct financial harm.

cross_references.title: Gov. Code § 13959 — Hearing and Appeal
cross_references.relationship: When CalVCB denies a claim inconsistent with the § 13950 purpose, § 13959 provides the mechanism to compel correct application of the statute.
